question: For Yale University, calculate the weighted average nine-month salary of full-time nonmedical instructional staff across professor, associate professor and assistant professor ranks in the 2024-25 release. Weight each rank's nine-month average salary by its nine-month staff count. Exclude all other ranks and the all-ranks total.

outputs.label: Weighted average 9-month salary, full-time nonmedical instructional staff (professor, associate, assistant), Yale, 2024-25

assumptions: Weighted mean of each rank's 9-month average salary (all genders) weighted by that rank's 9-month staff count.
Only ranks professor (1), associate professor (2), assistant professor (3); all-ranks total (7), instructor, lecturer and no-rank excluded.
Covers staff on 9-month contracts only, not equated 9-month salaries.
Academic year 2024-25 release, staff as of November 1, 2024.

question: For Yale University, calculate the weighted average nine-month salary of full-time nonmedical instructional staff across professor, associate professor and assistant professor ranks in the 2024-25 release. Weight each rank's nine-month average salary by its nine-month staff count. Exclude all other ranks and the all-ranks total.

outputs.label: Staff-weighted average 9-month salary, full-time nonmedical instructional staff (professor, associate, assistant), Yale, 2024-25

assumptions: Weighted average = sum over ranks of (9-month average salary SA09MAT x 9-month staff count SA09MCT) divided by sum of SA09MCT, for Professor, Associate professor and Assistant professor only.
Excludes Instructor, Lecturer, No academic rank and the all-ranks total.
Covers only staff on 9-month contracts; period is academic year 2024-25.
